title.narrative: Hospital de Colonia- apoyo a l

description.narrative: UNOPS is providing technical assistance through infrastructure implementation and project management services to the Government of Uruguay’s State Health Services Administration (Administración de Servicios de Salud del Estado/ASSE) for the construction of a new hospital in Colonia del Sacramento, Colonia Department in south-western Uruguay. The existing Colonia hospital is an old building, in order to provide modern health services that meet the needs of the city, UNOPS is supporting ASSE in the construction of a new 50 bed facility.
